reviewItem.question: If an exposed environment does nothing about "fix: Add beta trace for namespaced resources by @man-ish-k in https://github.com/crossplane/crossplane/pull/6549", what happens, and is that review or action? proposed: none

consequence.statement: The addition of beta tracing for namespaced resources has no operational consequence for environments that do not explicitly enable or use this tracing capability.

proposed.statement: A beta trace capability is added for namespaced resources in Crossplane.
